question_text: For each data set, obtain the power model which best fits the data:

subparts.solution: The correlation coefficient $r$ is very close to 1, so the fit is excellent. The power is very close to 5, so it is reasonable to conclude that $y$ is directly proportional to $x^5$. The model is $y \approx 0.0353x^5$.

ai_explanation.concept_rule: Power regression fits $y = ax^b$. When $b$ is near an integer, we infer direct proportionality to $x^b$.
step_by_step: Round parameters to 3 significant figures to write $y \approx 0.0353x^5$.

mark_breakdown.desc: Observe power $b \approx -2$ indicating inverse square relationship

subparts.solution: The correlation coefficient $r$ is very close to $-1$, so the fit is excellent. The power is very close to $-2$, so it is reasonable to conclude that $y$ is inversely proportional to $x^2$. The model is $y \approx \frac{72.6}{x^2}$.

ai_explanation.concept_rule: A power regression with negative power $b = -n$ corresponds to an inverse relationship $y = \frac{a}{x^n}$.
ai_explanation.common_pitfalls: Misinterpreting a negative power as a linear negative correlation.
